lines.en: I wind up waking up without Ami's assistance, which is strange given that today is a[school] day...so I quickly begin going over possible explanations for this in my head.
Explanation 1: She was murdered.
Explanation 2: Today is some sort of national holiday that I am unaware of.
Explanation 3: She was murdered and today is some sort of national holiday that I am unaware of.
I'm really hoping it's not that last one because it sounds like it would make arranging her funeral very difficult.
I walk out into the kitchen and prepare myself for whatever crime scene awaits.
However, what awaits is no crime scene at all...
It's simply the girl who didn't wake me up this morning, half-passed out with a huge blanket I have never seen before pulled over her body.
: I think...I might be dying...
: Well, at least you're not dead already.
: When is breakfast?
: I don't...think I can make breakfast today, Sensei...
: I'm really sorry...
: Yeah...I was kind of expecting that to be the answer. But that doesn't mean I can't be upset about it.
: I'll make you...two breakfasts tomorrow to make up for it...
: Don't even worry about it, Ami. Just...get some rest and...stop being sick.
: I don't think you would make a very good doctor...
: I don't think I would make a very good anything, so that's fair.
So, as you may have noticed, the reason Ami wasn’t able to wake me up this morning is because she’s suddenly fallen ill.
The part I don't get is why she'd decide to be sick out here instead of in her room.
: This is it, Sensei...I'm really going to die...
: You're not going to die, Ami...
: Please don’t...forget me when I’m gone...
: I'll never forget you. Not until I get my last two breakfasts.
: Hahah...hah...hah...so...funny...
: What's wrong, exactly? Is it anything medicine could fix? Or...
: My everything hurts and I have a fever.
: You took your temperature already?
: Yes...
: And what was it?
: Six million.
: Did you take your temperature on the sun?
: The real answer is...102...
: I think it's probably the flu or something...
: It took every bit of strength I had to even pick up the thermometer...
: Sensei...what am I supposed to do? If I can't take care of you, what am I even good for?
: Hey, I'm sure there's plenty of other stuff you're good for. I'm just blissfully unaware of it right now.
: Plus, it would only be fair if I took care of you sometimes in return, right?
: I can't ask you to do that...
: Why not?
: Because that's...not how this goes...
: Well, that's how it goes today. What can I do? What do you need?
: You have to go to[school], Sensei...You can't stay here with me.
: I’ll call the school and let them know that neither of us will be coming in today.
: If it really is the flu, I've already been exposed to it by talking to you, so we're both screwed either way.
: Are...you really okay with that?...Staying here with me?...
: Of course. The quicker you recover, the quicker I can eat again.
: That and I don’t like seeing you acting like you're on the brink of death. It’s depressing.
: Well...it’s not like I really enjoy feeling this way either...
: But you don't have to take care of me, Sensei...What will you do if you actually do get sick and have to miss more than one day of[school]?
: You should...abandon me while you have the chance...
: If that happens I'll just...miss more days, I guess. It's not a big deal.
Now that I think about it, I’m not really sure how time off even works at my job.
Do I even get time off? How does calling out sick as a teacher work, exactly?
: Hey, on the bright side...if I actually do get sick, that means you can take care of me next. And that doesn’t sound all that bad, does it?
: Unless we’re both sick...Then Maya and Ayane will have to come over and take care of us.
: I doubt Maya will touch me so she'll probably be with you and Ayane will probably be with me.
: I’m...kind of worried about how Ayane would take care of you, to be totally honest...
: So am I, Ami. So am I...But let’s not worry about that for now.
: Instead, how about you tell me what I can do to make things more comfortable for you. Are you hungry?
: Hungry, no...Maybe a little thirsty, though...
: Do you think you could get me a glass of water?
: Sure. I’ll be right back.
I move to the kitchen and remove a thick plastic cup from one of the cabinets.
There's a design on the cup that has become cracked and splintered from a mixture of age and being washed an ungodly amount of times.
It's barely visible anymore...but I'm pretty certain that, at some point, it was a sakura tree.
I fill the cup with filtered water from a pitcher in the fridge and grab a sleeve of crackers as well, just in case Ami wants to put anything in her stomach.
After quickly calling the[school] to let them know we won't be coming in today, I return to the couch and save Ami's life.
: Ahhh...this is the worst...I feel so useless.
: Less complaining, more hydrating. Drink this.
I place the water and crackers on the table in front of Ami and she slowly but surely begins to sip from the glass.
: Thank you, Sensei...I promise to get better as quickly as I can, okay?
: Don’t worry about that for now. Just try and get some sleep.
: That’s what I’ve been trying to do all morning...as you can see, it’s not exactly working.
: I even tried sleeping out here because my bed was starting to feel uncomfortable from how much I was rolling around.
: Well, I can't imagine that couch feels much better.
: It doesn't...but at least trying to go to sleep out here gave me the chance to see you...
: You know I would have gone into your room anyway, right? I was pretty sure you were killed when I wasn't woken up this morning.
: Heheh...sorry about that...
: I knew you'd find me either way...but every second counts, Sensei...especially now that I am fading away once and for all...
: If you fade away in the next half hour, I might be able to retract my call out from work.
: Heheh...in that case...I guess I'll just have to hang on for as long as I can...
: Good call. You just beat out nine other girls in a battle for my time, so it's probably safe to say I have a bit of a soft spot for you and don't want you to die just yet.
: Heheh...I did beat them all...didn't I?
: I guess...family comes first for both of us...huh?
You know...
Maybe keeping up this whole ‘family’ facade won’t be as hard as I initially thought.
I mean...I really do feel like Ami’s guardian. And that's even more true now that I'm finally seeing her at her most vulnerable.
There are no impure thoughts at all right now- just the true desire for her to get better so I won't have to look at her like this anymore.
I'm sure the fantasies will float right back in once she's able to do things on her own again...but for now...
I'm content just being near her.
And that's not something I think or say very often.
: Hey...umm...
: I just thought of...something else that might make me feel a little better...
: Oh yeah? What now?
: Well, I'll tell you, but...you'll be pretty much asking to get sick if you actually go along with it.
: I don't really mind that. Shoot.
: Would you...maybe want to lay here with me for a little while?
: Are you sure that won't make you even more uncomfortable? You have a fever, don't you?
: Yeah, but...
: I can't imagine having you so close to me would ever make me more uncomfortable...
: Well, I guess I don't really have a choice then. Move over.
: You mean...you're actually going to do it?
: Of course. We're going to have to squeeze together since the couch is so small, though.
: Yeah...of course! I don’t mind at all! Here...get in behind me...
: I wanna be the little spoon today...
Ami slides both herself and the pillow up a few inches and stops right before falling off of the couch.
She's close enough to the edge that I have to step over her very carefully so as to not knock her off the couch entirely and speed up her descent into the underworld.
Once I'm in place, I attempt to level my head with hers and drape one of my arms over her body to protect her from falling.
In the act of doing so, though, I may be unintentionally assisting her in...falling in different fashion.
But at least the hurt that will come with that will be all in her head.
: Heheh...I feel kinda like a little girl again...
: Remember how I used to not be able to fall asleep unless you cuddled me at night?
: Or is that gone too?...
It's times like this when I wish I could have inherited the memories of this body along with its skin.
I don't even care that they'd belong to someone else- I just want to understand and connect the way I'm supposed to be able to.
Call it envy if you like- this desire to absorb the life before me...
But I don't think it's envy at all.
I think that if I am going to keep living this life, I deserve everything that is supposed to be packaged with it.

There is no point in cracking open a shell with nothing inside of it. And right now, I'm afraid that “Yes, I remember that” will cause a series of cracks to begin splintering across the surface of my conscience.
I'm worried that, before long, the cracks will grow bigger. And that people will realize there was never anything inside of me at all.
And yet-
I'm going to lie anyway.
I'm going to lie because that is the easiest thing to do right now.
And because it's the thing that will hurt this girl the least.
: Yeah...
: I remember that, Ami.
: Good...I knew there were some bits and pieces of me left in there.
: In fact, I'm still not entirely convinced this whole amnesia thing isn't just some really long prank you can't figure out how to end.
: That would require a level of dedication I simply do not have, Ami.
: Sensei...do you think I’ve changed at all in the last few years?
: Changed? What do you mean?
: Like...do I maybe seem more...grown up now?
: Because...I’ve been trying really hard, you know?
: To grow up?
: Maybe not...specifically that...
: It's more like I'm just trying to be someone that you can rely on...for everything.
: You saved me when I had nowhere else to go...so ever since then, I've been trying to do the same for you.
: And sometimes...I really think I'm doing that.
: But other times...it's like you don't need me at all.
: Those are the moments I'm most afraid of.
: I know it probably sounds selfish to want you to be useless without me, but...I mean...I'm useless without you, you know?
: So...I don't think it would be a bad thing if you just so happened to lean on me a little more. All you really need to do is-
: Ami, aren’t you supposed to be trying to sleep right now? Staying awake and talking to me isn't going to make you feel any better.
: Hehehe...you're right...
: I'm sorry, Sensei...will you ever forgive me?
Ami slides closer to me, breaking the gap between us and pushing her butt up against my crotch.
I do my best to harken back to my earlier thoughts of wanting nothing more than to be close to her, but I'm forced to abandon that in order to prevent myself from getting aroused instead.
Turns out I'm weaker than I thought.
I'm only able to survive for about two or three minutes before I get hard and wind up accidentally sandwiching my erect dick between Ami's butt cheeks.
After it happens, though...she doesn't move at all.
She just...accepts it like it's second nature- which is honestly a little shocking since I expected at least some sort of reaction.
She notices. She has to. There's no way she doesn't.
Every few minutes or so, she’ll readjust, sometimes pushing slightly harder into me...but never anything more than that.
Is she waiting for me to do something?
Should I do something?
: Sensei?
: Yeah?...
: I really love you, you know.
: Like...more than anything in the whole world.
: And I’m not just saying that cause we’re family.
: I’m saying that because it’s something I want you to remember any time you’re feeling down.
: I want you to know that I’m totally fine with you always relying on me in any way you need to.
: I know I’m not feeling well now...but I promise to get better soon so I can go back to taking care of you. Okay?
: Yeah...okay...
: I love you too, Ami.
: Heheh...it always makes me happy to hear you say that...
: I feel like that's the first time in a while, though...
: Yeah...
: Yeah, it is...
For me, it's the first time ever.
At least the first time with her.
I'm sure I uttered those words in my previous life...but for whatever reason, the memory of ever doing that is just as black as everything else.
But...I said it.
It might not be true. In fact, it probably isn't true...I'm not even sure if I fully understand what love is.
But I said it.
And I will now have to suffer the consequences for saying it.
But...
The words worked like a lullaby and put Ami to sleep just minutes later.
As for me-
My erection remained and I spent the next several minutes trying to prod her out of her dreams.
It didn't work.
So I returned to my bedroom and pleasured myself to the thought of her.
I imagined pulling her pajama pants down while she was still asleep.
I imagined warming her up with my fingers.
I imagined parting her legs, tainting her thighs with the residual juices I forced her body into creating in its fit of ill unconsciousness-
And I imagined the words “I love you” being spoken once more- this time between the gasps and moans she'd make as my cock sinks into her.
I would never say it back.
But I would prove my love regardless.
I imagine it dripping down her back like morning dew on a bed of flowers.
Ami slept through the rest of the day.
I pleasured myself five more times.
